description: This file defines the class ImportMapGoogle, which extends ImportMapOther, and provides a method getMapping for retrieving default field mappings for a specific module, particularly for Google contact imports within the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: ImportMapGoogle
classes.description: A class that provides default field mappings for importing contacts from Google, extending ImportMapOther.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns an array of field mappings specific to the module, including standard contact fields and additional address and communication fields. Tailored for Google contact import scenarios.
